finding_in_original_report: The current S02 bibliography note was reported as incorrectly using correction DOI 10.1063/1.457669.
actual_finding: The exact locked current bibliography already binds S01 to 10.1063/1.457669, S02 to 10.1063/1.457672, and S03 to 10.1063/1.457670. Each matches retained publisher-origin correction metadata. No bibliography edit is needed.
cause: The Round3 derived review transcribed a historical S02 note into the exact_bibliography_fields field for the current bibliography. The root consolidation failed to catch that transcription error. Re-reading the actual unchanged BibTeX entry and publisher metadata exposes it.
